items.title: Add audited verification intent repair from existing evidence
items.context: Create a narrow repair command for mid-flight stories whose checklist items lack verificationIntent while passing verificationEvidence already exists. Preserve authored intent and require explicit legacy reason outside PLAN.
items.userSees: A user can run one Lattice command to repair a legacy story instead of hand-editing story metadata.
excludes: Do not make evidence alone pass normal review gates.
Do not rewrite existing authored intent by default.

happy.desc: A PLAN-phase story has passing verificationEvidence refs such as CHK-001:happy:0 but no stored verificationIntent -> lattice verification_intent_repair with mode=fromEvidence dryRun prints reconstructed intent, and the non-dry run writes only the missing lane/index entries plus an audit event; WHY: proves the mid-flight legacy repair path exists without hand-editing story metadata.

edge.desc: A checklist item already has authored verificationIntent on one lane while other evidenced lanes are missing -> repair preserves the authored text and fills only missing entries unless replaceExisting is explicitly requested with a strong reason; WHY: protects the acceptance contract from accidental overwrite.

A DEV/REVIEW/TEST story needs legacy repair -> command rejects missing legacyRepair or a short/empty reason, then succeeds with legacyRepair=true and a substantial reason while recording phase/reason/head/material audit data; WHY: verifies protected-phase mutation stays explicit and auditable.

adversarial.desc: Evidence refs are malformed, point at unknown checklist items or lanes, or represent failing evidence -> repair reports the problematic refs, does not guess generated intent, and leaves checklist intent unchanged; WHY: prevents evidence from becoming a silent or lossy substitute for authored intent.

items.title: Make review and validation diagnostics name the repair path
items.context: When missing verificationIntent has matching evidence refs, story_review and validate should still block but explain that this is a legacy schema repair case and show the repair command.
items.userSees: A blocked reviewer sees a precise next command instead of a generic missing-intent error.
excludes: Do not downgrade blocker severity for normal stories.

items.title: Use configured gitRoot for INIT_CHECK worktree bootstrap
items.context: Worktree creation must run git operations from the signed workspace material root when metadata root is only a wrapper directory, while preserving existing story metadata semantics.
items.userSees: A valid wrapper-root project with gitRoot can enter INIT_CHECK without manual worktree creation.
excludes: Do not move metadata storage into the nested git repository.

items.title: Cover repair and bootstrap behavior with focused smokes
items.context: Add smoke coverage for evidence-to-intent repair, non-overwrite behavior, malformed refs, protected phase reasons, nested gitRoot bootstrap, invalid gitRoot diagnostics, and the current help-command health check.
items.userSees: The regression suite proves the incident path will not silently return.
excludes: Do not add broad fixture rewrites or unrelated validation framework changes.

items.title: Sync documented behavior with implementation and built runtime
items.context: Update requirements docs and package build outputs only where the implemented CLI behavior requires it, then verify the global-runtime path can expose the new command after build.
items.userSees: After main is updated and built, global Lattice users can apply the documented repair path consistently.
excludes: Do not expand into unrelated docs navigation cleanup.
